# tmux

**Terminal multiplexer for sessions that outlive the connection**

- **Version recorded:** 3.5a
- **Categories:** `workstation`
- **Upstream:** <https://github.com/tmux/tmux>

## What it does

Splits one terminal into multiple panes and windows, and keeps them running after you disconnect so you can reattach later from anywhere.

## Why you would want it

A station machine is frequently headless or reached over SSH from a laptop, and a long capture or a decode run should not die because the link dropped. It is the multiplexer to reach for; screen is carried alongside it only because other people's instructions name screen.

## Before it will work

Nothing.

## How it installs

- apt: `tmux`

## Known problems

Version differences change the configuration syntax between targets — Debian 13 and Parrot ship 3.5a, Kali ships 3.7b — so a config copied from a blog post may fail to parse. Nothing in this catalog ships a tmux config.
